title: Source successor lifts for the twice-reduced principal tower
statement: Let J be an essentially small site, R a commutative ring, r a nonzerodivisor generating I, and K a derived R-module sheaf. Tensor the derived principal-power quotient tower of K and its constant-source augmentation by R/r. For every n there is a backward map from level n+1 of the reduced quotient tower to level n of the reduced constant tower. Its composite with the augmentation at n is the quotient-tower successor transition, and the augmentation at n+1 followed by the backward map is the constant-tower successor transition.

proof.text: The two principal coefficient triangles at consecutive powers form a commutative square with source map r and target map identity. Tensor by K and then R/r. Multiplication by r is zero after the first reduction. The lifting lemma for two distinguished triangles with zero first arrows gives the backward maps and both required equations. Compose with the tensor-unit comparison to put the backward map in the constant-source tower. This is the complete existing source proof.

lemma exists_lift_whiskerRight_derivedCompletionCone
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ b : (derivedCompletionDiagram J I K ⋙ ⊗ᴸR/ϖ).obj (op (n + 1)) ⟶
        ((Functor.const ℕᵒᵖ).obj K ⋙ ⊗ᴸR/ϖ).obj (op n),
      b ≫ (Functor.whiskerRight (derivedCompletionCone J I K).π ⊗ᴸR/ϖ).app (op n) =
          (derivedCompletionDiagram J I K ⋙ ⊗ᴸR/ϖ).map (homOfLE n.le_succ).op ∧
        (Functor.whiskerRight (derivedCompletionCone J I K).π ⊗ᴸR/ϖ).app (op (n + 1)) ≫ b =
          ((Functor.const ℕᵒᵖ).obj K ⋙ ⊗ᴸR/ϖ).map (homOfLE n.le_succ).op
